note: Authenticator clause: TestRFC3748OneMethodPerConversation (a Type-13 Response once MS-CHAPv2 is active draws nil, no success; unproven, no record). Peer clause: TestRFC3748ThePeerKeepsToOneMethod: an EAP-TLS Request to a peer mid-MS-CHAPv2 is discarded (no Response, no Err), and the same peer then acks the MS-CHAPv2 Success with Type 26 and concludes. Records are whole-body panics of handleRequest, so Q2 for the discard is answered by reading, not by the record.
